title: Unit-typed tools-policy manifest
body: GSD-2 declares per-unit-type tool surfaces in a `UnitContextManifest` (planning units cannot Write; execution units can; researchers cannot Edit). CI guards the manifest. Stratum already has per-step tool restrictions but they're per-call; lifting them to per-step-type with a CI-checked manifest is the same shape, sharper. Prevents drift like "the planner agent silently gained Edit and started writing code from a planning step."
